units.source_text: 连载告别赛情况的各报记者都云集在这里。

en.t: Reporters from the various newspapers serializing accounts of the farewell match had all gathered here.

units.source_text: 据他们说连每周的悬奖也能招来许多读者。

en.t: According to them, even the weekly prize contest could draw in many readers.

units.source_text: 因为每星期六都征集读者的意见，看下一子该下哪一手，猜中者获奖。

en.t: That was because every Saturday they solicited readers' opinions on what the next move should be, and those who guessed correctly won a prize.
I also broke in and said to the reporters:
